item.title: Farm Becomes Wildlife Retreat: Olivia Newton-John reshaped Dalwood estate; sale tied to cancer work
item.description: Olivia Newton-John owned a country estate in Australia that she transformed over nearly four decades. This property included natural features and a significant amount of wildlife habitat that she developed. After battling cancer, the estate was sold in 2019 for $4.6 million, reflecting changes in her priorities. Newton-John's connection to the area continued through her involvement with a wellness retreat she co-founded. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Exhausted Chinese working mums book solo hotel stays to escape childcare and sleep
item.description: Across China, a growing number of middle-aged working mothers are quietly checking into hotel rooms alone, desperate to get a few hours of uninterrupted sleep. Caught between demanding daytime jobs and an exhausting “second shift” of housework and parenting, many women see these solo hotel stays as their only real escape, according to multiple mainland reports. item.title: Dorothy Dandridge Home Listed: Former Hollywood Hills residence hits $5.499 million; price up nearly 90% from 2014 sale
item.description: A stunning Mediterranean-style home in Hollywood Hills, once owned by the iconic actress Dorothy Dandridge, is now on the market for nearly $5.5 million. Covering 4,368 square feet, the residence boasts four luxurious bedrooms and five opulent bathrooms. Dandridge's impactful legacy as a pioneering Black actress echoes through this property, complemented by breathtaking views of Los Angeles. The current owners have thoughtfully renovated it while respecting its historic charm. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: TOI Real Estate Desk

item.title: ‘Less than a minute’: Hong Kong travellers praise Japan’s new tax refund at airports
item.description: Hong Kong tour groups returning from Japan have praised a smooth roll-out of the country’s new tax refund arrangement that requires travellers to complete refund procedures at airports or ports rather than at shops. Under the “pay first, refund later” scheme, which took effect on Sunday to curb illicit domestic reselling and tax evasion, international tourists must now pay the 10 per cent consumption tax upfront at the counter. Travellers are now required to complete customs verification before... Fuente: South China Morning Post.
item.dc:creator: Danny Mok,Eric Jiang

item.description: En Buenos Aires, jóvenes debatieron sobre entornos digitales en el marco de la iniciativa Círculos de la Paz de Naciones Unidas. Desinformación, el impacto de las redes sociales en la salud mental y crecer en la era de la inteligencia artificial fueron los principales temas. Fuente: Noticias ONU.

item.title: Prince’s former Beverly Park estate gets $13.5M price cut
item.description: The sprawling estate at 77 Beverly Park Lane is listed for $54.5 million after a significant price cut. It features nine bedrooms, 15 bathrooms, and a private theatre for entertaining guests comfortably. The property was previously owned by developer George Santopietro and boasted historical significance due to Prince's residency. The landscaping showcases resort-style grounds designed by a renowned landscape designer. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.description: Deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s (DRC’s) Ebola outbreak have topped 5,000 as the country grapples with the relentless spread of the disease and cases are recorded in other African countries, the latest government data on Saturday shows. Data from the government’s Ministry of Health showed that the disease has killed 5,026 people out of 10,351 infected, at a nearly 50 per cent lethality rate. item.title: Persson Lists Beverly Hills Mansion: asks $70 million again; ultra-luxury LA market cools
item.description: Markus Persson, the mastermind behind Minecraft, is putting his lavish Beverly Hills mansion on the market for $70 million. This expansive property boasts eight bedrooms and 15 bathrooms, along with one-of-a-kind features like a candy room and a nightclub. Acquired in December 2014 after selling Mojang to Microsoft, this listing highlights both the opulence of the home and the difficulties of navigating the high-end Los Angeles real estate landscape. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Africa suffering in ‘strongmen’ era, says governance watchdog
item.description: Democracy and rights are declining in Africa as leaders take their cues from the rise of strongmen in other parts of the world, the head of a governance monitor told AFP. Mo Ibrahim, 80, is a Sudanese-British billionaire who made a fortune in telecoms and ploughed it into monitoring and encouraging better governance across Africa. The Mo Ibrahim Foundation’s latest report, finds broad progress on economic opportunity and human development over the past decade, but also steep declines in... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: Third weekend of protests looms as tensions persist across France
item.description: For the third Saturday in a row, people across France are set to take to the streets to protest against the high cost of living and demand better funding for education. item.title: Meet 12-year-old Indian-American Sophia Parekh, who has given over 8,000 free books to children
item.description: Sophia Parekh, a 12-year-old from Westfield, New Jersey, has distributed more than 8,000 free books to children across the US through Sophia's Book Stand, a project she started at age seven during the Covid pandemic. She personally selects books based on children's ages and interests and also supports teachers in underserved schools. Her efforts earned her recognition as a runner-up for the 2026 Gloria Barron Prize for Young Heroes. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
